name: Town Centre
tagline: Walkable core near markets and buses
description: The compact grid at the heart of Banos, centred on Parque Central and the basilica. Restaurants, tour agencies, cafes and the bus terminal sit within a few blocks, making it the most convenient base for short stays.
bestFor: Short-stay travellers who want everything walkable and easy tour access

name: Around the Basilica
tagline: Quiet blocks by the historic church
description: The streets surrounding the Basilica de Nuestra Senora del Agua Santa hold guesthouses and small hostels. It stays close to the centre but feels calmer, with easy access to the church, thermal baths and the market.
bestFor: Travellers wanting a quiet central base near baths and sights

name: Route of the Waterfalls Edge
description: The eastern side of town where streets thin out toward the Ruta de las Cascadas and the Pastaza canyon. Lodges and cabanas here offer greenery and views, with the Casa del Arbol swing and adventure trailheads a short ride away.
bestFor: Outdoor and adventure travellers who want nature at the door

name: San Vicente Hillside
description: The slopes rising toward the San Vicente viewpoint above town, reached by a footbridge over the Pastaza. Accommodations here trade walkability for panoramic valley views and a rural, restful atmosphere away from street noise.
bestFor: Longer-stay visitors prioritising views, quiet and slower days
cons: Need to walk down for services
